title: Software Engineer - C , Embedded, Multithreading , Netconf 4 - 8 years
teaser: Take on the role of Software Engineer to architect and develop the IOS-XR programmability and manageability stack, enabling automated operations management for service providers and web customers. Collaborate with a diverse team to deliver innovative, scalable solutions. Ideal for experienced engineers with expertise in C, Python, and network programming.
description:
Meet the Team 

Cisco IOS-XR team Manageability team is responsible for programmability stack exposing Cisco’s Flagship IOS-XR Operating System as an API. This small team is responsible for delivering a highly innovative, scalable, and reliable programmatic OS to Cisco’s Campus, Branch, Service Provide Edge, and hyper scalers market Segments that will be deployed on Millions of devices and help to generate Billions in revenue annually. 

Your Impact 

You  will be part of a phenomenal team of engineers with a diverse set of experiences and knowledge who develop the next generation machine to machine interface, manageability technology stack (grpc, netconf), and tooling to enable network automation at scale. In this role you will have an opportunity to learn and for us to learn from you.

Architecting and Evolving IOS-XR Programmability

Development of the XR programmability/manageability stack for enabling fully automated operations management for service provider and web customers

Simplifying the architecture by reducing memory footprints and  improving performance to meet customer expectations and enabling modularity for ease of maintenance

Implementing model-driven APIs and programmability features to enable seamless integration with modern tools and workflow 

Minimum Qualifications (Provide up to five (5) bullet points - these should be clearly defined, objective, non-comparative, relevant, and quantifiable to appropriately evaluate applicants – not including soft skills): 

Bachelor’s degree with 6+ years of related experience, or a Master’s degree with 4+ years of experience

Expert knowledge and hands-on experience with C and Python

Proficiency in writing functional code, unit testing, and debugging.

Network and multithread programming

Experience with Linux, Kernel Programming and Open-Source technologies

Preferred Qualifications (Provide up to five (5) bullet points:  these can include soft skills)

Good understanding of regular expressions and CLI parsers

Experience in API programming, Netconf,  gRPC based services, network programming (TCP/IP) 

Experience with Open config models and services like netconf, grpc, gnmi, gnoi is a plus 

Prior development experience in Cisco IOS-XR product  

Why Cisco? 

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
